name: House Cleaning

maintenance_plan.name: Recurring cleaning
maintenance_plan.pitch: Weekly, every-other-week or monthly visits at a set price, with the same cleaner or team whenever possible. Recurring visits cost less per clean than one-time cleanings because the house never gets far behind.

headlines: Come home to a clean house every other week.

Move-out cleanings that hold up to the landlord's walk-through.
subheads: Background-checked, insured cleaners who follow a room-by-room checklist every visit.

services.name: Recurring house cleaning
services.short: Weekly, every-other-week or monthly cleaning at a set price.
services.long: Every visit covers the kitchen, bathrooms, floors, dusting and the rooms you live in most, following the same checklist so nothing gets skipped. You can leave notes for the team and rotate in extras like baseboards or the inside of the microwave.
bullets: Kitchen: counters, sink, appliance fronts and stovetop
Bathrooms: toilets, tubs, showers and mirrors
Beds made and trash taken out

services.name: Deep cleaning
services.short: A top-to-bottom clean that gets the buildup regular cleaning misses.
services.long: A deep clean takes longer than a regular visit because it covers the details: baseboards, door frames, light switches, cabinet fronts, vents and built-up soap scum and grease. Most new recurring customers start with one, so regular visits can keep the house at that level.
bullets: Soap scum, hard water spots and grease
Vents, light fixtures and ceiling fans

services.name: Move-in and move-out cleaning
services.short: Empty-home cleaning, inside cabinets and appliances, ready for the walk-through.
services.long: An empty house shows everything. We clean inside cabinets, drawers, the oven, the fridge and closets, spot clean scuffed walls and leave it ready for a landlord's or buyer's walk-through. Send us your landlord's checklist and we'll follow it.
bullets: Spot cleaning on walls and doors

services.name: Vacation rental turnovers
services.short: Turnovers between guests, with linens, restocking and photos of the finished unit.
services.long: We clean between check-out and check-in, change linens, restock the supplies you keep on site and send photos when the unit is ready. We also flag damage or missing items so you can deal with them before the next guest arrives.

services.name: Post-construction cleaning
services.short: Fine dust, stickers and paint drips cleaned up after a remodel or build.
services.long: Construction dust gets onto every surface and keeps settling for days. We vacuum, wipe every surface from top to bottom, clean windows and tracks and remove stickers and residue from new fixtures. Bigger jobs may need a second pass after the dust settles.
bullets: Dust removed from walls, trim, vents and floors
Sticker and residue removal from fixtures
Cabinets and drawers wiped inside and out

services.name: Office cleaning
services.short: Small offices and storefronts cleaned after hours on a set schedule.
services.long: We clean small offices, studios and storefronts after hours or before opening, on a schedule that fits your business. Restrooms, break rooms, floors and trash are covered every visit, from a checklist you can see.
bullets: After-hours visits with key or code access

services.name: Add-on services
services.short: Inside the oven and fridge, interior windows, laundry and baseboards.
services.long: Add any of these to a regular visit or a one-time clean. They're priced per item, so you only pay for what you want done.

process.title: Get a price
process.detail: Tell us the size of your home and what you need, and we'll give you a flat price.

process.title: First clean
process.detail: We start with a deep clean or a longer first visit to bring the house up to a baseline.

process.title: Regular visits
process.detail: Your cleaners follow the same checklist each time, plus any notes you leave.

process.title: Tell us how it went
process.detail: If we missed something, let us know within 24 hours and we'll come back for it.

guarantees: Re-clean guarantee: tell us within 24 hours and we come back at no charge
Flat price quoted before the first visit
trust.badges_hint: Homeowners care most that cleaners are insured, bonded and background-checked, so state those plainly if true. ISSA Residential (formerly ARCSI) membership, BBB accreditation and green cleaning credentials help. Commercial clients may ask for a certificate of insurance. The certifications listed are examples (PHC is ISSA Residential's Professional House Cleaning certification; CIMS and Green Seal GS-42 apply to commercial cleaning); keep only the ones the business holds.

faqs.q: How much does house cleaning cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of the home, how often we come and its condition. Recurring cleaning for an average home usually runs $120 to $250 per visit. A first deep clean or a move-out clean costs more, often $250 to $500 or more. We give you a flat price before the first visit.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home?
faqs.a: No. Most customers give us a key, a door code or a lockbox code. Keys are stored securely and are never labeled with your address.

faqs.q: Do you bring your own supplies?
faqs.a: Yes, we bring all supplies and equipment, including vacuums and microfiber cloths. If you'd like us to use your products, or you have allergies or surfaces like marble that need special care, just tell us.

faqs.q: Will I get the same cleaner each time?
faqs.a: We schedule the same cleaner or team for your home whenever we can, so they learn how you like things done. If someone is out sick or on vacation, we'll let you know who's coming instead.

faqs.q: What isn't included in a regular cleaning?
faqs.a: Regular visits don't include the inside of the oven or fridge, interior windows, laundry or moving heavy furniture, though you can add most of those. We don't clean up biohazards, pest droppings or mold, and we don't work above step-stool height.

faqs.q: Are your cleaners insured and background-checked?
faqs.a: Yes. Every cleaner passes a background check before their first job, and we carry liability insurance and bonding. We can send a certificate of insurance on request.

Accidents are rare, but if something is damaged, we'll tell you right away and make it right through repair, replacement or our insurance. Let us know about anything fragile or valuable before the first visit.

faqs.q: How do I skip or reschedule a visit?
faqs.a: Call or text us at least 48 hours ahead and we'll move or skip the visit. Holidays and vacations are easy to plan around if you tell us early.
